meta.title: Mobile MACD — SIM Swap — Process Flow

lanes.name: External Systems
lanes.hint: Qnomy, IDWise, MOI, WinCash, Medallia, Downstream provisioning

nodes.label: Customer Visits Retail Store
nodes.desc: Customer visits Retail store for SIM SWAP.

nodes.label: Qnomy Ticket Created
nodes.desc: QTicket is created in Qnomy for the selected service chosen by the customer. Retail agent shall select the next available ticket in the queue and will provide respective service to the customer.
controls: Only one process can be initiated per transaction.

nodes.label: Customer Identification
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to identify the customer by searching: 1. Customer Name, 2. Mobile number, 3. Account ID, 4. Customer Identification number (Qatar ID, passport ID, GCC ID, diplomatic ID).
controls: Customer shall have existing customer account.
List of all the accounts matching to the search will be displayed by the system.

nodes.label: Verify the Customer
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view the verification questions and answers related to the customer in the screen. Agents shall be able to mark the customer as verified if customer response matches.
controls: All agent role (Retail agent, Telesales, Call center) shall be able to view the verification questions and manually match the answer.

nodes.label: ID Capture (IDWise)
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to scan the customer's ID using IDWise: a) Front Page, b) back page, c) Liveliness (optional if customer agrees).
controls: System (IDWise) shall be able to validate the ID Type and only allow: QID, Passport, Diplomatic ID, GCC ID.
System shall allow to re-scan the ID if the ID-wise fails to capture information at previous attempt.

nodes.label: ID-Wise Capture Successful?
nodes.desc: System shall be able to capture customer information from the scanned ID and display it in the UI, then send the scanned ID information to CRM. System shall capture the Expiry Date from ID wise and populate in CRM (as MOI is not returning Expiry date).

nodes.label: MOI Validation
nodes.desc: System shall be able to fetch the Customer information from MOI based on QID and Passport No (from all countries). MOI will return captured fields (QID Number, 5 Name fields, Date of Birth, Nationality, ID Expiry Date, Salutation).
controls: System shall compare the MOI returned fields with ID wise captured fields.
System shall be able to compare fields between IDWise and MOI: First Name, Last Name, ID Number and DOB.

nodes.label: MOI Fields Match ID-Wise (100%)?
nodes.desc: If all fields match (100%) then agent shall be allowed to proceed, else agent can reject or re-scan (from ID Capture).

nodes.label: Customer Check
nodes.desc: System shall be able to verify if customer exists or not.
controls: If Nationality, ID Type and ID Number are matching with the existing customer records then system will override the latest information from MOI.

nodes.label: Save Milestone
nodes.desc: System shall save the journey milestone upon successful validation.

nodes.label: Customer 360 View
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to view customer information through the Customer 360 View.
controls: The system shall navigate to the Customer 360 View when the agent scans a valid customer ID and a matching customer record is identified.

nodes.label: Initiate SIM Swap
nodes.desc: Agent should be able to initiate the SIM Swap Request.

nodes.label: Automatic Ticket Creation
nodes.desc: As agent initiates the MACD Process, System shall create the trouble ticket automatically and assign it to the agent.
controls: System shall pre-default the trouble ticket category, Type, Sub-Type.
Other mandatory fields for creating trouble ticket will be captured during design phase.

nodes.label: SIM Swap Form
nodes.desc: Agent should be able to capture the SIM Swap Form from customer with Signature. Agent should be able to attach the SIM Swap form in the portal.
controls: System should attach the Signed SIM Swap Form.

nodes.label: SIM Swap Reason
nodes.desc: Agent should be able to capture the SIM Swap reason and requested SIM Type.
controls: System should provide all the predefined SIM Swap reasons and SIM Types.
SIM Swap Charges will be applicable based on the selected reason.

nodes.label: SIM Swap Charges
nodes.desc: System shall automatically calculate the SIM Swap Charges based on the reason and SIM Type selected by the agent.
controls: Lost SIM is chargeable.
Faulty SIM is free.
eSIM is free.
eSIM-to-physical chargeable.
Charge rules should be configurable.

nodes.label: Cart Creation
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to create the cart (order) with SIM Swap. Agent shall be able to review and modify the reason and SIM Type before submission.

nodes.label: Save Milestone
nodes.desc: System shall save the journey milestone upon successful validation.

nodes.label: Verify Cart
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to review and validate before proceeding to payment.
controls: System shall perform all customer, account, product, compatibility validations prior to payment initiation.
System shall prevent order progression until all mandatory validations are successfully completed.

nodes.label: Payment Processing
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view the payment summary before confirming the payment, initiate payment through WinCash, and provide the customer copy of the receipt generated by WinCash (even if customer doesn't need to pay upfront, WinCash will generate receipt for zero payment).
controls: System shall display the payment summary and total payable amount prior to payment processing.
System shall send the upfront payment request to WinCash and update the payment status in CRM based on the response received.

nodes.label: Payment Successful?
nodes.desc: If payment fails, the system shall place the order on hold and return the agent to the payment summary screen for re-attempt.

nodes.label: Order Placement and Activation
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to submit the order and create an Activity in UI with Description of the activity as a free-text field to capture the order-specific details (used by other advisors to better understand the customer's history).
controls: System shall submit the order to downstream systems for backend provisioning and Activation.
System shall send acknowledgement and order confirmation to customer through the selected mode (Email/SMS).

nodes.label: Customer Notification — Submission
nodes.desc: System shall send order submission notification to customer through the selected mode (Email/SMS).

nodes.label: All Orders View from Customer 360
nodes.desc: System shall navigate the agent to Customer 360 -> All Orders View after order is submitted to the downstream systems. Agent shall be able to check the recently submitted order and their status.

nodes.label: Order Completion
nodes.desc: System shall get the order completion from downstream systems to CRM once the order is completed (SIM Swap completed).

nodes.label: Trouble Ticket Update
nodes.desc: System shall update the ticket with 'Resolved' status.
controls: System shall update the Order Number in the Trouble Ticket details.
System shall update the mandatory fields while making the TT Status Resolved.

nodes.label: Feedback Survey (Medallia)
nodes.desc: Once Order is completed, System shall send the information to Medallia for sending the Customer Feedback Survey. System shall also receive the Survey Status from Medallia in CRM.
controls: System shall keep the trouble ticket in Resolved status until the Survey is not completed.
System shall automatically mark the Trouble ticket as Closed once all order tasks/activities are completed.

nodes.label: Customer Notification — Completion
nodes.desc: System shall send acknowledgement on order completion to customer through the selected mode (Email/SMS). System shall send notification on order completion to all the MSISDNs which are available under the QID (e.g. if a Customer account with QID has 5 contacts/MSISDNs active then notification will be sent to all 5 MSISDNs for the successful activation of any MSISDN).

flows.label: Payment fails — order on hold, re-attempt

start.title: Customer Visits Retail Store
start.does: Customer walks into a Retail store requesting a SIM SWAP.
start.makes: A service request that triggers the Qnomy ticketing process.
start.example: Customer visits Retail store for SIM SWAP.

qticket.title: Qnomy Ticket Created
qticket.does: A queue ticket is created in Qnomy for the selected service; agent picks next ticket.
qticket.makes: QTicket assigned to next available agent.
qticket.example: Only one process can be initiated per transaction.

cust_id.title: Customer Identification
cust_id.does: Agent searches for the customer's existing account.
cust_id.needs: Customer Name, Mobile number, Account ID, or ID number (QID/Passport/GCC/Diplomatic).
cust_id.makes: A matched customer account or list of matching accounts.

verify_cust.title: Verify the Customer
verify_cust.does: Agent asks verification questions and matches answers to the account on file.
verify_cust.needs: Customer's verbal responses to security questions.
verify_cust.example: Date of Birth, city of birth, Last Name.

id_capture.title: ID Capture (IDWise)
id_capture.does: Agent scans the customer's physical ID document via IDWise.
id_capture.needs: Front page, back page, optional liveliness check.
id_capture.makes: Scanned ID data submitted to CRM.
id_capture.example: QID, Passport, Diplomatic ID, GCC ID accepted.

id_capture_result.title: ID-Wise Capture Successful?
id_capture_result.does: System checks whether IDWise successfully captured the document information.
id_capture_result.makes: Either a re-scan request or proceeds to MOI validation.

moi_validation.title: MOI Validation
moi_validation.does: System fetches customer identity information from MOI using QID/Passport number.
moi_validation.example: First Name, Last Name, ID Number, DOB, Nationality, ID Expiry Date, Salutation.

moi_match_check.title: MOI Fields Match ID-Wise (100%)?
moi_match_check.does: System compares MOI fields against IDWise-captured fields.
moi_match_check.needs: Both IDWise and MOI field sets.
moi_match_check.makes: Proceed if 100% match, else agent rejects or re-scans.
moi_match_check.example: First Name, Last Name, ID Number and DOB compared.

cust_check.title: Customer Check
cust_check.does: System verifies whether the customer already exists in CRM.
cust_check.makes: Overrides existing record with latest MOI info if matched.
cust_check.example: Existing customer record found and refreshed.

save_milestone_1.title: Save Milestone
save_milestone_1.does: System records a journey milestone after successful identity validation.

c360_view.title: Customer 360 View
c360_view.does: Agent views full customer information in the Customer 360 screen.
c360_view.makes: Consolidated customer view for the agent.
c360_view.example: Navigates automatically after valid ID match.

init_sim_swap.title: Initiate SIM Swap
init_sim_swap.does: Agent starts the SIM Swap request for the customer.

auto_tt.title: Automatic Ticket Creation
auto_tt.does: System auto-creates a trouble ticket for the MACD process and assigns it to the agent.

sim_swap_form.title: SIM Swap Form
sim_swap_form.does: Agent captures the signed SIM Swap form from the customer and attaches it.
sim_swap_form.makes: Signed SIM Swap form attached to the case.

sim_swap_reason.title: SIM Swap Reason
sim_swap_reason.does: Agent records the reason for the swap and the requested SIM type.
sim_swap_reason.needs: Reason code, current SIM type, requested SIM type.
sim_swap_reason.makes: Reason and SIM type selection used to drive charges.
sim_swap_reason.example: Reason: Lost SIM; requested: physical SIM.

sim_swap_charges.title: SIM Swap Charges
sim_swap_charges.does: System auto-calculates SIM Swap charges based on the reason and SIM type.
sim_swap_charges.makes: Charge amount applied to the order.
sim_swap_charges.example: Lost SIM chargeable; faulty/eSIM free; eSIM-to-physical chargeable.

cart_creation.title: Cart Creation
cart_creation.does: Agent creates an order cart containing the SIM Swap.

save_milestone_2.title: Save Milestone
save_milestone_2.does: System records a journey milestone after cart creation.

verify_cart.title: Verify Cart
verify_cart.does: Agent reviews and validates the cart before payment.
verify_cart.makes: Validated cart ready for payment initiation.

payment.title: Payment Processing
payment.does: Agent reviews payment summary and initiates payment through WinCash.
payment.makes: WinCash transaction and customer receipt (including zero-payment receipts).
payment.example: Payment Method, Amount, Receipt Number, Transaction Number.

payment_result.title: Payment Successful?
payment_result.does: System checks the WinCash payment response.
payment_result.makes: Order proceeds, or is placed on hold and returned to agent for re-attempt.
payment_result.example: Failed payment returns agent to payment summary screen.

order_placement.title: Order Placement and Activation
order_placement.does: Agent submits the order and logs an activity note for other advisors.
order_placement.makes: Order submitted to downstream systems for provisioning/activation.

notify_submission.title: Customer Notification — Submission
notify_submission.does: System notifies the customer that the order was submitted.

all_orders_view.title: All Orders View from Customer 360
all_orders_view.does: Agent is navigated to the All Orders view to track the submitted order.
all_orders_view.makes: Visibility into order status for the agent.
all_orders_view.example: Agent checks recently submitted SIM Swap order.

order_completion.title: Order Completion
order_completion.does: CRM receives order completion confirmation from downstream systems.

tt_update.title: Trouble Ticket Update
tt_update.does: System updates the trouble ticket to Resolved status.
tt_update.makes: TT updated with Order Number and mandatory closure fields.

feedback_survey.title: Feedback Survey (Medallia)
feedback_survey.does: System sends completion info to Medallia to trigger a customer feedback survey.
feedback_survey.makes: Survey sent; survey status received back into CRM.
feedback_survey.example: TT remains Resolved until survey completes, then auto-Closed.

notify_completion.title: Customer Notification — Completion
notify_completion.does: System sends final completion acknowledgement to the customer and all MSISDNs under the QID.
notify_completion.needs: Completed order, list of MSISDNs under QID.
notify_completion.makes: Email/SMS completion notifications to all associated MSISDNs.
notify_completion.example: 5 MSISDNs under one QID all notified of successful activation.
